snippet.title: Shadow Sacrament | World Premiere The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
"Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil is a gothic survival horror adventure that blends classic survival horror tension with 2D Metroidvania-inspired exploration and brutal, visceral combat. Set within a sprawling, isolated monastery in the 19th century, players assume the role of a detective investigating a gruesome crime, only to uncover a sinister mystery lurking within its walls. Featuring meticulously crafted pixel art, fluid animations and relentless encounters, Shadow Sacrament delivers a chilling descent into madness. Explore interconnected environments, solve intricate puzzles, and confront grotesque monstrosities while carefully managing ammunition, stamina and resources.

Wishlist Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002550/Shadow_Sacrament_The_Roots_of_Evil/

Follow Shadow Sacrament:
https://x.com/eldritchhousegs
"---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
